name: SMS spam logistic regression
limitations: Trained on historical English SMS spam, which is not the same as a modern scam dataset.
Cannot reliably assess Malay or other unsupported languages, novel scams, or image-only content.
Spam-like wording can appear in legitimate offers; a low score is not a guarantee.

dataset.split_method: Stratified 70/15/15 after token-normalized deduplication; phone numbers, URLs and emails normalized; seed 20261001
dataset.title: SMS Spam Collection
dataset.citation: Tiago Almeida and Jose Maria Gomez Hidalgo (2011). SMS Spam Collection. UCI Machine Learning Repository. doi:10.24432/C5CC84.

training.selection: Maximum validation ROC-AUC; held-out test accessed after model selection
training.operating_threshold_selection: URL 0.05/0.95 conservative triage after external benign-domain sanity checks, without optimizing test labels; SMS 0.2/0.8 preset; news always review
